prompt:
Create a precise BrineSpace CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET, landscape high-resolution. First image is character identity, natural facial rendering, proportions and costume authority. Next two images are the EXISTING diving helmet front and side hardware authority. Layout: four COMPLETE fullbody figures left-to-right: bareheaded front, HELMET ON front, HELMET ON right-side, HELMET ON rear, equal anatomical scale and aligned soles. At far right large face-through-visor portrait; below that small bareheaded face detail. Fit everything with whitespace, no clipped feet. Neutral charcoal background and clean labels. Wear same suit and equipment in every view. Helmet adds physical height without scaling body; seal onto pressure collar with connected neck. Steel-framed clear visor, graphite domed shell, small PURE NEUTRAL WHITE forehead lamp and white rear lamp; NO amber or yellow helmet lights, side fittings, NO opaque visor, face clearly recognizable, only one head in helmet. Bun/hair must fit INSIDE shell. No sci-fi redesign, bubble helmet, floating collar, exaggerated glow or body hue tint. Match finely painted realistic faces of first reference, sharp material edges with restrained game-art texture, no coarse pixel exaggeration or blur. Clearly letter exact full name and role provided. No marketing slogans. These are static design proposals, not animation frames.
